title: The Home page, next version — round 1, the lights card again

steps.path: Pages → Home, Destin's Room, lights card open
steps.headline: The All row is now the lights card's header, and each light sits indented beneath it on a guide line, inside the card.
steps.changed: Before, All and each light were the same tile side by side, so the lights did not look like they belonged to All. Now the card has one border; All is its top row, a line separates it, and the lights are indented under it.
steps.notice: Folded, the card is just its header row, the same size as a single light's tile.
steps.risk: The indent makes each light a little narrower, so the colour swatches wrap onto one more line.
